name: unity-cli
description: Bring your coding agent into Unity: inspect projects, drive the Editor, and build and test with current CLI guidance.

interface.longDescription: Keep Unity work moving from your coding agent. Inspect a project, prepare its Editor, run builds and tests, and work with a live Editor through Unity Pipeline. The bundled skill checks installed commands and project versions before acting, then verifies the result.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Unity project and tell me what is ready to build.
Run the relevant Unity tests and explain any failures.
Connect to my running Unity Editor and inspect the scene.
